verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync. That is a first-party claim of programmatic access, but the evidence contains no developer documentation, endpoint reference, auth model or confirmation the API is public. Missing for 10: published API reference/developer docs, details of which mailbox operations (scans, forwarding, deposits, labels) are exposed, authentication and access terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
